Hi Alex / Marissa 4

Thanks for looping me in. A few clarifications from the security side: 

- Bridge letter: provided in draft by Marissa; signed copy will be delivered within 3 business days once the routing is approved.
- Logs & retention: default request/trace logs are retained 30 days. We can extend retention for Dedicated or Private deployments via contract if your audit requires longer retention windows.
- Data protection: all customer data is encrypted in transit (TLS 1.2+) and at rest (AES-256). Access to production artifacts is strictly role-based; audit logs are available in the Trust Portal.
- HIPAA / BAA: Redwood supports HIPAA-covered use cases and will execute a BAA for hosted customers under standard terms. For highly regulated customers we also offer a Private deployment option to give additional network isolation controls.
- GDPR: we have Data Processing Addendum (DPA) language and can support EU data subject requests.

I'll attach the signed bridge letter when available and can share the BAA template if you'd like to review. Let me know any specific controls you need called out in the questionnaire and I can respond inline in the portal.
